detail.reason: Customer reports spam mislabeling bug on Saturday termite calls and competitor CallRail's same-day Google Ads sync, plus praise for call summaries.

assignments.name: CallRail undercuts on Google Ads sync
AI call summaries save staff time

decisions.ruleName: Signal AI bugs → Signal AI team
decisions.reason: matched rule "Signal AI bugs → Signal AI team" (priority 51)

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: Morning, both. [PERSON_1], uh, I see you're on the road, so we'll keep this moving. So, [PERSON_2], how's fall treating you?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Busy. Aeration season plus termites, which is a fun combo. How about you?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: Good, good. Last QBR of the month for me, so so you're getting the tired version.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: You're on speaker, by the way. I'm between the Cary shop and the Apex one, so if it cuts out, it's a dead zone on 64.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: No problem. I pulled the numbers for the quarter, want me to walk through the top level first?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Yeah, please.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: So total tracked calls across the six locations were up about 14% versus the same quarter last year. Google Ads is still your biggest source by volume, and the aeration landing page is, let me see, second.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: That tracks. We pushed more budget into the fall campaign, so I'd hope it's up.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: The thing I actually look at is the signal breakdown. Appointment booked is up, quote given is up, so the leads look real, not just more calls.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: Right, and that's what I wanted to show you. Signal volume on booked appointments was up 19%.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Okay, that's good. Hold on, sorry, someone's honking at me. Go um, ahead.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: You're fine. [PERSON_2], anything stand out on your side?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: One thing, and it's small but it's been bugging me. Saturday mornings, when people call about termites, a bunch of those get marked as spam and they're real.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: Okay. Is it the swarm calls specifically, or any Saturday call?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Mostly the ones where the caller is kind of frantic, short call, they don't give a lot of info. I think the signal just doesn't have enough to go on.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: Got it. How many are we talking, roughly?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: I'd say eight or ten a Saturday over the last month. Not huge, but those are people with an active swarm in their wall, so they're not nothing.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: Yeah, that's real money walking away. Can you send me two or three call IDs from last Saturday? I want to look at what the transcript looks like on those.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Yeah, I can pull those this afternoon.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: Perfect. I'll take it to the team and see what we're working with. I don't want to guess at it from here.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Appreciate that that. And listen, while we're on it, CallRail called me again. They say their Google Ads sync is same-day, and I'll be honest, that got my attention.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: Fair. What's driving it, the timing of the conversions landing in Google Ads?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Part of it. I just don't like feeling like I'm behind on the bidding side when a competitor's telling me they're a day ahead.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: He gets a call from somebody every couple months. I mostly ignore them.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: I mostly ignore them too. This one just landed different.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: Understood. I'm not going to argue with you on it. What I can do is get you the actual picture on how your conversions are flowing into Google Ads right now, and then you can decide if the timing matters for your campaigns.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: That's all I'm asking. I don't want a sales pitch, I want to know what's actually happening.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: Right. I'll pull that and follow up with you directly.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Okay. Sorry, I gotta take this other call, it's the Apex manager. [PERSON_2], you got the rest?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: I got it.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: [PERSON_3], talk soon.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: Yep, take care.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: He does that. Okay, where were we.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: We were on signals, and we can stay there or move to whatever you want. How's the day to day with the platform?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Honestly, the call summaries are the first thing I read every morning, they save me so much time.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: Good to you know, hear. Do you read them per location or all together?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: All together first, you know, then I drill into Raleigh and Cary if something looks off. It's like a ten minute scan instead of listening to twenty calls.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: And the rest of it, tracking numbers, routing, all behaving?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Yeah, it's fine. No complaints there.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: Good. Anything on the the Google Ads side from your end, besides the timing thing [PERSON_1] raised?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: No, that's the one. I mean, I'd love for him to stop taking those calls, but that's not a product thing.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: Ha, yeah, that one's on you. So on the spam mislabels, walk me through what you do now when you catch one.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: I just flag it in my own spreadsheet and move on. I didn't know if there was anything to actually do about it.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: Okay. So send me the call IDs and I'll dig in. If it's a pattern on Saturday mornings specifically, that's useful for us to know.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Will do. I'll put them in an email so you have them.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: Perfect. Anything else on your list before we wrap?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: That's it, really. The season's going well, we're just trying to keep up.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: That's a good problem. I'll send the recap today with the numbers and the two follow-ups, the call IDs and the Google Ads timing.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Great. And I'll get you those calls by end of day.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: Sounds good. Tell [PERSON_1] I said good luck with the drive.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: I will. Thanks, [PERSON_3].

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: Thanks, [PERSON_2]. Talk soon.
